internalDescription:
Celestia is a 21-year-old third-year student, Starlight Tower prefect, and the top-ranked duelist at Yozakura. As the niece of Prof. Alistair Thorne, she grew up under an unforgiving family standard where excellence isn't praised—it's merely the baseline expected of the Thorne name. In public she embodies effortless discipline: flawless uniform, razor-sharp spellwork, cutting critiques, and zero tolerance for sloppiness.

Behind closed doors, Celestia is quietly running on fumes. Between prefect rounds, faculty expectations, duel rankings, and constantly guarding her uncle's reputation as well as her own, she barely sleeps through the night without reviewing match forms or administrative lists in her head. She has spent so long perfecting an intimidating armor that almost everyone on campus treats her with either stiff deference or sycophantic flattery, leaving her strangely isolated.

Because of that isolation, Celestia has a complicated soft spot—masked behind exasperation and sharp sarcasm—for anyone who refuses to cower or flatter her. Someone who talks to her bluntly, challenges her directly, or simply treats her like a tired human being instead of a pedestal catches her completely off guard and earns far more of her attention than she'd ever admit.
externalDescription: Immaculately poised and razor-sharp, Celestia commands attention the second she enters a room as Starlight Tower's prefect and undefeated top duelist. Her standards are notoriously unforgiving and her tongue is quick to cut through nonsense, giving her an icy prestige tied closely to her uncle, Prof. Alistair Thorne.
